name: AI form builder
note: A multi-tenant, white-label form builder: describe a form in one plain sentence and get a complete, branded, working form, with e-signatures and server-side token caps that keep AI costs flat.
problem: Form tools were rigid, generic or priced for enterprise, and none used AI to remove field-by-field building. The output also had to be reliable enough for paying tenants: a strict, valid schema every time.

approach.title: Prompt to schema
approach.text: A tightly constrained OpenAI prompt returns a strict JSON form schema, validated on the server before anything renders.

approach.title: Tenant isolation
approach.text: Row-level security in Supabase and PostgreSQL keeps each workspace’s forms, submissions and branding apart.

approach.title: One renderer
approach.text: A single white-label renderer turns any schema into a branded, responsive form, with no custom code per customer.

approach.title: Signatures and audit
approach.text: Signature capture and submission storage with audit timestamps for compliance-sensitive forms.

approach.title: Cost control
approach.text: Cached schemas and tuned prompts keep the token cost of each generation predictable.

features: Save and return later, one-time links

testimonial.quote: Venus built exactly what we envisioned and honestly, better.
testimonial.name: Punit K.
